Material Data & Test Values

Published temperature ranges, hardness bands, tensile values, compression set figures and physical properties are typical values for the compound family, determined in our laboratory under the standards named on the relevant page. Those standards include ASTM D2240 and ISO 48-4 for hardness, ASTM D412 and ISO 37 for tensile and elongation, ASTM D395 and ISO 815-1 for compression set, ASTM D573 and ISO 188 for heat ageing, ASTM D297 and ISO 2781 for specific gravity, and ISO 6502-2 for cure characteristics.

Ozone resistance, fluid immersion ageing, low-temperature brittleness, abrasion, tear, rebound and flammability testing are carried out through a NABL-accredited partner laboratory rather than in-house, and are available on request.

Test values are not performance guarantees. Actual performance in service depends on the specific formulation, part geometry, cure state, installed compression, service medium, temperature, pressure and duty cycle. A compound that performs to a published range in a laboratory test may behave differently in your assembly.

Certified values for the compound supplied on a specific order are issued as inspection release data with that despatch lot. Where you need values certified before ordering, ask us and we will arrange testing.

Dimensional conformity is held to ISO 3302-1, classes M1 to M4 for moulded components and E1 to E3 for extruded sections, as recorded on the drawing. Tolerance follows the section — a simple cord holds tighter than a large hollow profile, and a single tolerance figure cannot be quoted across a product range.
Suitability for Your Application
Selection of a compound, hardness and geometry for a given application remains the responsibility of the specifying engineer.

We will recommend a compound against the operating conditions you provide — the fluid or media in contact, the operating temperature range, the load or pressure, and the duty cycle. That recommendation is only as good as the information it is based on. We cannot assess conditions we have not been told about, including intermittent exposures, cleaning chemicals, ozone, UV, and thermal cycling outside the stated range.

Where a component is safety-critical, or where failure would cause injury, environmental release or significant consequential loss, the buyer should qualify the part in the actual application before series release. We will supply samples for that purpose and welcome being told the result.

We do not hold approvals for regulated end-use applications. Specifically, we do not hold ISO 13485 or FDA registration for medical devices, and we do not hold NORSOK M-710 or API elastomer qualification for oil and gas service. Where a component forms part of a product requiring CE or UKCA marking, the conformity assessment obligation rests with the manufacturer or importer of that product, not with us.
